registries.usage: External references only; resolve files and checksums in that registry at the pinned commit. No entries are copied into this registry.

Upstream Hermes registry, federated whole: catalogs/federated/hermes-registry.json snapshots its index metadata at the pinned commit; files and checksums are resolved in that registry. Nothing is copied.
registries.consumerSupport: Itonami Registry site and API; Cloud Itonami Marketplace (agents)
